source: tools/rocks/build-rocks.mjs + tools/rocks/pack-rocks.mjs (Poly Haven CC0 scans, see docs/credits.md)

envelope.note: Each variant is normalised to the water-sim rock ellipsoid: scale uniformly by r and put the origin at the world.json rock centre (x, y, z). Footprint: mean radius in the ground band (y -0.4..0.2) ~1.0-1.05, never above rMax (<=1.3). Top = +0.62 exactly, bottom = -0.62 exactly. Above visibleKnee the scan keeps its proportions (vertical/horizontal scale ratio vertRatio, horizontal anisotropy aniso <= 1.4); below it the buried part is stretched to reach the envelope bottom (sink is 20-40 %, so the ground sits at y-0.372r..y-0.124r).

placement.worldJson: rocks[i] = [x, y, z, r, yaw, kind, tone, inWater]; kind 0 sarsen, 1 flint, 2 cobble
placement.instanceMatrix: compose(T(x, y, z) * Ry(yaw) * S(r)) * node.matrix  -- node.matrix is the meshopt dequantisation (KHR_mesh_quantization); fold it into every instance matrix, or convert the position/normal attributes to Float32 BEFORE geometry.applyMatrix4(node.matrix) (applyMatrix4 on the normalized Int16 positions clamps to [-1, 1] and shreds the mesh)
placement.variantPick: variant = kind.variants[hash(i) % kind.variants.length] (any stable hash of the rock index)
placement.lod: kinds 0/1: draw <name> (LOD0) near, <name>_lod1 beyond ~ 40 * r metres (screen height < ~4 %); cobbles have no LOD1: hide beyond ~60 m or fade into terrain
placement.noMirror: do not mirror (negative scale) instances: InstancedMesh does not flip winding per instance
placement.tone: per-instance tone 0..1: albedo *= mix(0.85, 1.12, tone); also a slight hue swing mix(vec3(1.03,1.0,0.95), vec3(0.96,0.99,1.03), tone)

materials.rock_sarsen: 2048 colour atlas (ETC1S), 1024 normal (UASTC), 512 roughness in G (ETC1S, no AO), grey-brown graded scans with natural lichen, light moss on 2 of 9
materials.rock_flint: 1024 colour (ETC1S), 512 normal (UASTC), 512 ORM (R = baked AO, G = roughness); procedural flint: dark glossy conchoidal scars (rough ~0.38) + chalky cortex (rough ~0.88) + patina rim + iron staining
materials.rock_cobble: 1024 colour (ETC1S), 256 normal (UASTC), 256 ORM; flint, brown flint and chalk-lump looks
materials.sharing: one material per kind; every variant of a kind shares its atlas, so one InstancedMesh per variant (and per LOD) keeps one material/texture set per kind

shading.note: Albedo is moss-free apart from light natural lichen on the sarsens; the runtime adds moss, wetness and algae procedurally (TSL). Suggested recipe:

moss.mask: up = smoothstep(0.35, 0.85, Nw.y); north = smoothstep(0.0, 0.7, -Nw.z) * smoothstep(-0.2, 0.35, Nw.y)  (north = -Z); m = saturate(0.75*up + 0.6*north) * smoothstep(0.42, 0.62, fbm(Pw * 1.7)) * kindAmount; no moss below waterY + 0.04 (algae there instead)
moss.normal: blend the normal map 50 % towards the geometric normal under moss (moss fills the micro relief)
moss.lichen: sarsen only: cellular spots (freq ~5/m, density 0.12) of pale grey-green vec3(0.33, 0.35, 0.29) and rare yellow vec3(0.42, 0.34, 0.10), on sides and tops

wet.inputs: waterY = local water surface (sim height at the instance, or pond level 0.09 for the millpond); h = Pw.y - waterY
wet.submerged: h < 0: albedo *= 0.55; roughness = 0.22; algae film: albedo = mix(albedo, vec3(0.05, 0.06, 0.025), 0.35 * smoothstep(-0.03, -0.15, h))
wet.splashBand: band = 0.05 + 0.04 * noise(Pw * 6); 0 <= h < band: wet = 1 - smoothstep(0, band, h); albedo *= mix(1, 0.6, wet); roughness = mix(base, 0.2, wet)
wet.bankRocks: inWater = 0: a soil-damp band just above the terrain: albedo *= mix(0.78, 1, smoothstep(0.0, 0.12, (Pw.y - groundY) / r)); after rain scale everything by the global wetness

shading.contact: no baked ground AO: let the terrain/SSAO handle contact; flint/cobble ORM.R carries self-occlusion only
